pay.body: Clear price before you pay. No registration, no stored card details.

deliver.title: Delivered
deliver.body: Printed, cut and passed into the opening — follow each step live.

proof.title: A slip of paper, a closed path, a sensor that sees it pass.
proof.body: Each unit is a quiet stone-coloured column beside the tziyun. Inside, a thermal printer prints your kvittel, cuts it fully and releases it into a closed chute that leads to the kvittel opening.
proof.honesty: We only show “Delivered” when the hardware confirms it. If a sensor cannot confirm, we tell you so — and a person reviews it. Nothing is ever printed twice automatically.

printed.title: Printed
printed.body: Exactly as in your preview — the same layout engine, the same fonts.

cut.title: Cut
cut.body: A full cut separates your kvittel from the roll.

chute.title: Passes the sensor
chute.body: An optical sensor in the chute registers the slip on its way down.

delivered.title: Delivered
delivered.body: You see the time of delivery in the tziyun’s local time.

diagram.aria: Diagram of the field unit: printer, cutter, closed chute and optical sensor leading to the kvittel opening

honesty.title: Honest status

permission.title: With permission

physical.title: Truly physical
physical.body: Your words become paper at the tziyun — not an email, not a screen.

cta.title: Whenever you are ready.
cta.body: Write your kvittel now. It will wait in the queue until the tziyun’s next service window.

included.title: What is included
included.print: Printing of your kvittel on site, exactly as previewed
included.cut: Full cut and release through a closed chute
included.tracking: Live status in the tziyun’s local time
included.notIncluded: Not included: a person praying on your behalf, or any promise of an outcome.

hours.title: Service hours
hours.policy: No printing on Shabbat and Yom Tov, nor after midday on Fridays and the eve of Yom Tov. Orders wait safely in the queue.

map.title: Map
map.unverified: Exact coordinates are awaiting verification and are not shown yet.

how.title: From your hand to the opening
how.intro: Every step is real and visible — from the words you type to the moment the slip passes the sensor at the tziyun.

choose.title: Choose the tziyun
choose.body: Search by name, nickname or city in any spelling. You can send the same kvittel to several tziyunim in one order.

write.title: Write in your own words
write.body: Add names (with mother’s or father’s name if you wish), choose topics, and write freely. Suggested phrases are optional.

preview.title: See the exact slip
preview.body: The preview is drawn by the same engine that prints it — on 58 mm paper, in Hebrew, Yiddish, Latin or Cyrillic.

pay.title: Pay securely
pay.body: The final price is fixed before you pay. Card details never reach us; payment is confirmed only by the payment provider’s signed message.

queue.title: Queued with respect for time
queue.body: The unit prints only during the tziyun’s service hours — never on Shabbat or Yom Tov.

print.title: Printed and cut
print.body: The unit receives an image of your kvittel (never readable text), prints it and cuts it fully.

chute.title: Through the chute
chute.body: The slip falls through a closed chute into the kvittel opening; an optical sensor registers its passage.

notify.title: You are told the truth
notify.body: You see each step live. If the hardware cannot confirm, we say so and a person reviews it.

honesty.title: What we do not claim
honesty.body: This is a physical delivery service. We do not pray on your behalf, and we promise no spiritual outcome. A status is only shown when it actually happened.

what.a: Your kvittel is printed on paper at a unit beside the tziyun, cut, and released through a closed chute into the kvittel opening. You can follow every step.

prayer.a: No. We provide physical delivery of the note you wrote. We do not pray on your behalf and promise no outcome.

proof.q: How do I know it was delivered?
proof.a: An optical sensor in the chute registers the slip. “Delivered” is shown only after that confirmation. If a unit has no sensor, we say so explicitly.

privacy.q: Who can read what I write?
privacy.a: Your text is encrypted and only turned into an image at the moment of printing. Our staff cannot read it by default, it is never written to logs, and it is deleted after delivery.

language.q: Which languages can I write in?
language.a: Hebrew (with niqqud), Yiddish, English, French, Russian and other Latin or Cyrillic languages. Emoji cannot be printed — we will tell you before payment.

handwriting.q: Can I send my own handwriting?
handwriting.a: Yes. Upload a photo; you can rotate it and adjust contrast. We never change or ‘correct’ your words.

shabbat.q: What about Shabbat and Yom Tov?
shabbat.a: Units do not print on Shabbat and Yom Tov, nor after midday on the eve. Your kvittel waits in the queue and prints afterwards.

uncertain.a: Sometimes the hardware cannot confirm a step — for example, if power is lost mid-print. We never reprint automatically; a person checks and contacts you.

refund.a: If your kvittel was not delivered because of a fault, maintenance or a pause, you can choose a later delivery or a full refund.

account.a: No. You can order as a guest. An account lets you see history and save names — only with your explicit consent.

multi.q: Can I send to several tziyunim?
multi.a: Yes — add several tziyunim to one kvittel, or write different kvittlach. Orders with more than one delivery receive a bundle discount.

video.a: Not yet. A private delivery clip (showing only the slot, never people) is planned and will only be offered where installed and approved.
